verdict.rationale: Reflect has a documented public REST API with OAuth2 and PKCE auth and bearer-token access, plus a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec on openpm. The spec covers listing graphs, getting and creating links, appending to daily notes, creating notes and GET /users/me. The surface is narrow, though: the docs say end-to-end encryption means note contents cannot be served through the API, so an agent can write to Reflect but cannot read or search notes. Missing for 10: read/search/update access to note contents, versioning or deprecation policy, sandbox or test environment, independent hands-on corroboration.
